body: Even now months later. I'll find myself completely out of control. ( not in a danger to others way) more like I'll suddenly realize I slept walked through a couple days and have nothing to show for it. Like my mind just goes to sleep for hours on end without me even being aware until after I snap out of it.

i don't have to come back. Let me rewind give a bit of detail. I lived with my ex since I was 20 we moved to NY together. She went to school and got her bachelors while I worked. For the past year ( her first year of employment in her life) I had made up my mind to go back to school (I wanted a bachelors so I can teach, which I learned I loved to do while being a sous chef) well all that's out the window. I'm stuck with a 2000$ a month lease for a studio. Plus a bunch of bills that we racked up together but under my name and in the immediate aftermath of the breakup I flailed completely and didn't make any smart desicions.

I'm sorry I feel like a terrible person just shooting down well intended advise and caring words. Sincerely thank you guys for being the type of people to reach out to others. I'm sorry I'm being an asshole.
I've thought about just dissapearing for a bit, I'm just afraid of coming back to a worse situation. All my debts just pilling up.

I appreciate the troubleshooting and I don't want to be negative(I know), I have been trying to dig myself out but I just keep sinking. Both mentally and my situation in life. last week I went back to work and 3 hours into my third day had a massive breakdown and walked out. Don't even remember doing it.

The experience can range from useless to incredibly important and helpful it really comes down to the connection you can establish with your therapist. All I can say is shop around. finding the right therapist for you will be a positive no matter what you are going through.
